text_block_list.text:
Марузенски isn't here for training yet, so
I start to
get some other work done
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm afraid I can't tell you that...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But I had some urgent business to attend
to. So
cut me some slack, Jack! Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. You know I'll make up for
it!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: Just try not to be late next time.

text_block_list.text: Okay. I'm sorry for making you worry.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there must be a reason, and I
don't want
to be too strict... I decide not
to push the issue.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Later, I find out that Марузенски has
been trying
to help the underclassmen
with their problems.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
